newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN CHEMICAL SHARES DOWN ON BASF RESULTS.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN CHEMICAL SHARES DOWN ON BASF RESULTS.

text.p: Shares in Germany's Big Three chemical firms -- BASF AG, Hoechst AG and Bayer AG -- came under heavy pressure on Thursday after BASF released disappointing interm profits.
"The chemicals are out now," said one dealer.
"Hoechst was not particularly good and now BASF had no ace up its sleeve either," he added.
BASF fell 3.30 marks, or 4.57 percent, to 68.90 marks, Hoechst was down 4.10 marks, or five percent, at 76.90 marks.
Bayer suffered less dramatic losses and was trading at 73.75 marks, down 2.05 marks.
BASF reported a 5.8 percent rise in its first-half pretax profit to 2.46 billion marks -- at the lower end of expectations.
